title: Evaluating Personalized Tool-Augmented LLMs from the Perspectives of Personalization and Proactivity

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the systematic scoring bias and limits of agreement (LoA) between LLM-generated scores and human evaluations using the Bland-Altman method, specifically evaluating how providing manually annotated key-point constraints mitigates the evaluation model's divergence from human judgments.
